title: VXAce All but one weapons choices had disappeared in an attempt to make this a Kingdom Hearts style choice.

posts.author: DeadManDan98
posts.body:
I had fixed this problem where all the weapons were not visible, but I ran into another one. Here is the unlisted video I had recorded for you to see the problem and some screenshots I will snapshot in a moment after this. I would like to see what to do to solve this one.
video

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
I analyzed the screenshots, and they all seem correct.
However, from the video, it's noticeable that the
Rifle
weapon is the only one where page 2 is not activated.
I opened RMVXAce, used the same variable and the same event ID for each one, and it worked perfectly.
My best guess is that you changed something before capturing each page to post here, but you didn't test the game. Have the player start directly on the map with these devices.
Spoiler:
Extra tip
Use a template to correct your player's sprite so it doesn't look lame

posts.author: Zahawk
posts.body:
The four weapon pages should be set to 'Same As Characters' and 'Action Button'.
DeadManDan98 said:
three weapons but one can be selected
Click to expand...
Some are below characters which is what causes this.
Also some are 'player touch' which is inconsistent throughout so choose one to stick with.
Page 2s can stay as is.
As for the non-disappearing one, is it possible that you have it placed on the map as a tile? Eg. painted on as well as being an event with the event graphic?
